english: 100-109. On hearing that announcement in the assembly, a pure Brāhmaṇa among them who was eloquent, efficient and goodvoiced, proclaimed to the Brāhmaṇas repeating each statement three times. Clapping the hands at every statement he said: “If anyone is disinclined to go, he will incur the sin of those who utter falsehood, those who slander others, of a man who ravishes other men’s wives, who is engaged in harassing others, of those who imbibe liquor and are thieves of gold. Why make too much talk, O Brāhmaṇas? Let all excellent Brāhmaṇas go on.” On hearing that terrible utterance they decided to go.
